result.finding: Assessed 6 CWE rules in Concurrency & Synchronization: 6 FOUND, 0 NOT_FOUND
evidence: Reviewed Autofac service lifetimes, shared mutable state, locking, and access paths across request-scoped operations.

values.name: Use of Singleton Pattern Without Synchronization in a Multithreaded Context
values.description: The product uses the singleton pattern when creating a resource within a multithreaded environment.

evidence.explanation: ApplicationModule.Load registers CatalogServiceMock as SingleInstance when mock data is enabled (lines 18-22), but its per-instance mutable catalogItems list is accessed by request methods without synchronization.

values.name: Unsynchronized Access to Shared Data in a Multithreaded Context
values.description: The product does not properly synchronize shared data, such as static variables across threads, which can lead to undefined behavior and unpredictable data changes.

evidence.explanation: CatalogServiceMock.catalogItems is mutable shared state (line 12); CreateCatalogItem, UpdateCatalogItem, and RemoveCatalogItem modify it (lines 48-67), while read methods access it concurrently, with no synchronization.

values.name: Improper Synchronization
values.description: The product utilizes multiple threads or processes to allow temporary access to a shared resource that can only be exclusive to one process at a time, but it does not properly synchronize these actions, which might cause simultaneous accesses of this resource by multiple threads or processes.

evidence.explanation: The singleton CatalogServiceMock exposes concurrent collection reads and mutations without a lock or other synchronization, allowing overlapping requests to observe or modify inconsistent list state.

values.name: Improper Locking
values.description: The product does not properly acquire or release a lock on a resource, leading to unexpected resource state changes and behaviors.

evidence.explanation: CatalogServiceMock uses a singleton mutable list without acquiring a lock in its CRUD/read operations, so callers can concurrently alter the resource.

values.name: Missing Synchronization
values.description: The product utilizes a shared resource in a concurrent manner but does not attempt to synchronize access to the resource.

evidence.explanation: Autofac shares CatalogServiceMock across request scopes when mock mode is enabled (ApplicationModule.cs:18-22), but list access and mutation in CatalogServiceMock.cs:19-67 are unsynchronized.

values.name: Incorrect Synchronization
values.description: The product utilizes a shared resource in a concurrent manner, but it does not correctly synchronize access to the resource.

evidence.explanation: Although CatalogItemHiLoGenerator uses a lock, CatalogServiceMock does not synchronize access to its shared catalogItems list; concurrent create, update, delete, and read operations can race.
